name: devin-desktop-zh
description: Install full Chinese localization for Devin Desktop — 91k+ strings, 4 regional packs, one command on macOS, Windows and Linux
shortDescription: Chinese language pack for Devin Desktop

setup.notice: Applies a patch to the locally installed Devin Desktop app; the app must already be installed on the machine running the session.
steps: Start a session on the machine where Devin Desktop is installed
Ask Devin to run the devin-desktop-zh skill, then restart the app
Pick a language under Configure Display Language: 简体中文, 繁體中文(台灣), 繁體中文(香港) or 繁體中文(澳門)
